annotations.title: Open federal contract notices from Hawaiʻi offices

description: SAM.gov contract notices posted by offices in Hawaiʻi whose response deadline has not passed, from SAM.gov's public Opportunities API: title, notice type, agency path, NAICS code, set-aside, response deadline, place of performance as published, and the notice's public SAM.gov link (contacts, descriptions and attachments are only there). Listed in Hawaiʻi first (The Mine's own classification of the place of performance), then performed elsewhere. Award notices and justifications are not listed. Each notice and the list carry retrieved_at. Deadlines and details change; SAM.gov holds the current notice. Figures are public statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Each result has a coverage line that says exactly what the figure covers (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Each result carries the notice its source requires, and our Terms ask that it stay with the figure. Facts, not investment or other advice.
